mentions.name: go-llm
mentions.description: This is a locally-runnable AI assistant that supports voice notes through Telegram and connecting MCP servers, includes easter eggs, and runs in a single Docker container needing less than 100MB of memory. Email/calendar access is planned next.
mentions.source_excerpt: But you can run mine locally, and it has a couple of easter eggs ;-) as well as voice notes through telegram, connect MCP servers, and runs in a single Docker container needing less than 100MB of memory.
mentions.author: djthorpe
